card.name: Digits inside ISSN, ISBN and DOI codes
card.fires_on: A single digit in the middle of a long reference number, such as an ISSN, ISBN or DOI, in citation lists. It fires on digits after the first few characters of the code.

modes.label: ISSN digits
modes.description: A digit inside an ISSN number after the journal citation.
modes.example: versión impresa ISSN 1870-3<<4>>53 Rev. Mex. B

modes.label: DOI digits
modes.description: A digit within a DOI string in a reference.

modes.label: ISBN digits
modes.description: A digit within an ISBN for a cited book.

card.plain: It reacts to single digits in the middle of catalogue numbers like ISSN, ISBN and DOI in reference lists.
